units.source_text: 女人一只手放在水槽边上，偷偷摸摸往里瞧着似的，另一只手慢慢重复着搅拌的动作。

en.t: With one hand resting on the edge of the water tank, the woman seemed to be peering furtively inside, while with the other she slowly repeated the motion of stirring.

units.source_text: 男人把沙子和汗水濡湿得沉甸甸的衬衫猛地挥动了一下，啪地绕在手腕上。

en.t: The man gave the shirt, heavy with sand and sweat, a sharp swing, and it snapped around his wrist.
